SELECT task.id, task.report_name, task.report_rules, task.download_url, task.status, task.down_status, task.report_type, task.group_count, task.is_del, task.create_time, task.update_time, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT source.api_code ORDER BY source.id DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS api_codes, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT source.batch_number ORDER BY source.id DESC SEPARATOR ',') AS batch_numbers FROM b_report_task task LEFT JOIN b_report_task_score_source source ON source.report_id = task.id
task.is_del = 1 and task.report_type = 1
and task.report_name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
and source.api_code in
#{item}
GROUP BY task.create_time, task.id ORDER BY task.create_time DESC, task.id DESC
